# Vendored: @druxt-contrib/diff

Built from `druxt/druxt-diff`, commit `ad7435d9db80`.

Vendored rather than installed because the package is not published yet.
Written by `npm run vendor:sync -- diff <checkout> <ref>`: run that again
rather than editing these files, so this record stays true.

Declared as `file:vendor/diff` so the package name resolves in
`node_modules`, which a component or plugin template needs when it imports
the package by name.
